name: Browser Use
desc: Open-source library that lets agents drive a real web browser.
desc_zh: 开源库，让 Agent 直接驱动真实浏览器。
solves: Lets your agent operate websites through the DOM, so it can do the clicking and form-filling you would rather not.
solves_zh: 让 Agent 通过 DOM 操作网站，把点击和填表这类活交给它。
best_for: Reaching for it when your agent has to complete tasks on sites with no API.
best_for_zh: Agent 要在那些没有 API 的网站上干活时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：Show HN and r/LocalLLaMA threads; YC W25 company listing (40k+ GitHub stars)。来源：https://pypi.org/project/browser-use/
